title: Binance names co-founder Yi He co-CEO alongside Richard Teng

title: Crypto treasuries lead stock recovery after shaky start to December

title: BlackRock’s top brass says tokenization will bridge crypto and finance
summary: BlackRock is the largest asset manager in the world, with over $13.4 trillion in assets under management, and operates the largest tokenized cash market fund, worth $2.8 billion.

title: UK takes ‘massive step forward,’ passing property laws for crypto
summary: A bill clarifying that property laws apply to crypto was given royal assent in the UK, with advocates hailing the move as giving crypto “a much clearer legal footing.”

title: Bitcoin surges to $93K after Sunday flush, as analysts eye $100K

title: Crypto lobby slams Australian broadcaster’s ‘sensational’ Bitcoin article
summary: Australia’s government-funded national broadcaster, which reaches an average of over 12 million people, released a report on Tuesday that portrayed Bitcoin as a tool used by criminals with no real use or purpose.

title: Trump hint sends Kevin Hassett Fed chair odds soaring in markets
